decision: How is the reason revealed, and how much of it is visible at rest?
invariants: same 5 products and the same generated cutouts
same stone palette, Geist type, and --ease-out easing as app/globals.css
same placeholder reason copy, at deliberately uneven lengths (1 sentence to 4)
no purchase links, no ratings, no categories

options.bet: All five objects sit on one shared floor line at plausible relative scale; the reason opens in a panel below the row
options.benefit: Objects stay visible while the reason is read. Nothing covers the page, so it never repeats the bookshelf modal.
options.cost: One reason at a time. Page height changes when the panel opens.
options.risk: The panel can read as detached from the object that was clicked
options.observed: Five objects fit one row at 64rem. Longest entry (4 sentences) fits the panel with room to spare. Selected object is marked by weight plus a dot.

options.bet: Nothing is hidden. Every object and reason is on the page, alternating sides. No click target exists.
options.benefit: The reason is unmissable. Strongest layout at exactly five items.
options.cost: Abandons the user's stated click-to-reveal model. Longest page.
options.risk: Reads as a blog post rather than a collection
options.observed: Alternating rhythm holds. Objects render largest here. The one-sentence AirPods entry leaves visible slack beside a tall object.

options.bet: The user's stated model, literally: click a tile and the reason replaces the object inside the same tile
options.benefit: Grid never reflows. Most compact. Closest to the brief as written.
options.risk: Hides the only real content behind a click
options.observed: CONFIRMED COST: the 4-sentence entry is scroll-clipped inside the tile. A 3-column grid also leaves one empty cell at 5 items, which reads as unfinished.

known_gaps: All reason copy is placeholder; only 'I vlog using this' is the user's own.
Product images are Logitech MX Master 3S; the user said MX Master 3. Needs confirming.
Only the 1280 viewport was captured this round. 360 and 640 are checked at build.
